title: User locale preference and CI missing-key hard-fail
summary: Accounts store a per-user language preference (UK English today) so a second locale can be added later without schema work. Continuous integration now fails when a translation key is missing from en_GB, while unused keys stay informational.
changes: Add users.locale (default en_GB), SetLocale middleware, and supported_locales config with a language switcher that stays hidden until a second locale exists.
Keep Cloudron OIDC and directory sync from overwriting a stored locale; honour preferredLocale for notifications.
Flip php artisan lang:check to hard-fail on missing keys in CI; unused-key reporting remains non-blocking.
Document locale preference and CI hard-fail in docs/localisation.md; mark the Language line shipped in AGENTS.md.
version_rationale: Patch on the 0.38.x Language line: user locale groundwork and CI missing-key hard-fail after public SEO and Admin keywords (0.38.8). Closes milestone 8.
validation: PHPUnit UserLocalePreferenceTest, TranslationKeyHardFailTest, LocalisationBaselineTest, LocalisationAuthExtractionTest, PluginTranslationNamespacesTest.
php artisan myapes:changelog-validate --base-ref=origin/main on the PR branch.
known_limitations: Only en_GB is supported; the language switcher remains hidden until a second locale is added.
Accept-Language negotiation for guests is documented as off for now.
rollback: Redeploy the previous release package and roll back the users.locale migration if required. Locale middleware and CI hard-fail return to the prior report-only behaviour.
